milestones.title: DPR preparation authorised
milestones.description: Karnataka authorised preparation of Phase II DPRs, including RV Road - Bommasandra.
milestones.comments: Permission to prepare the DPR, not submission or approval of the completed DPR.

milestones.title: Karnataka project approval
milestones.description: State approval for Bangalore Metro Phase II, including RV Road - Bommasandra, under government order UDD 179 PRJ 2011.

milestones.title: Union Cabinet approval
milestones.description: The Union Cabinet approved Phase II, explicitly including RV Road - Bommasandra.
milestones.comments: The five-year completion period was envisaged from commencement of work, not from this approval date.

milestones.title: Formal Union sanction
milestones.description: The Ministry of Urban Development conveyed Government of India approval for implementation of Phase II.
milestones.comments: Separate from the January Cabinet decision.

milestones.title: Major civil contracts awarded
milestones.description: BMRCL records June 2017 awards for the three civil packages. ITD CEMINDIA JV covered packages 1 and 2; HCC-URC JV covered Bommanahalli - RV Road.
milestones.comments: Specialist reporting instead dates packages 1 and 2 to April 2017. Exact award days and the distinction between selection, LOA and agreement remain unresolved. June is the month recorded by BMRCL, not an established exact award date.

milestones.title: Package 1 piling begins
milestones.description: Piling for the first pier reportedly began in August 2017.
milestones.comments: Exact day not established. This is the earliest physical activity found in the supplied research, not proof of the first work anywhere on the corridor.

milestones.title: First pier reported complete
milestones.description: Contemporaneous specialist reporting documented the first Yellow Line pier near Electronic City, with photographs.
milestones.comments: The supplied research uses the report date. A separate contractor record establishing the precise casting day has not been obtained.

milestones.title: Package 2 final viaduct segment launched
milestones.description: The final segment of the approximately 6.385-km package 2 viaduct was launched in April 2021.
milestones.comments: The 11 April report refers to the preceding Tuesday; an exact day is not stored. This is a viaduct milestone, not completion of stations or systems.

milestones.title: Phased opening plan reported
milestones.revised_target: June 2023: Bommasandra - Central Silk Board; December 2023: Central Silk Board - RV Road
milestones.description: BMRCL linked the feasibility of a phased opening to rolling-stock availability.
milestones.comments: Reporting date; exact announcement day not established. The two sections did not share a June deadline.

milestones.title: Package 3 final segment launched
milestones.description: HCC-URC completed its final viaduct segment launch in September 2022.
milestones.comments: The 17 September report says 'last week'; its publication day is not the construction event date.

milestones.title: Full-corridor opening plan replaces phased plan
milestones.description: The BMRCL MD announced that the corridor would open in one go.
milestones.comments: Reporting date; exact interview day and the reason for changing the opening configuration need confirmation.

milestones.title: February 2024 opening expectation announced
milestones.description: An MP announced an expected opening, dependent on train availability and trials.
milestones.comments: An announced expectation, not regulatory authorisation or a confirmed opening date.

milestones.title: Opening target moves to year-end
milestones.previous_target: February 2024 expectation; other reporting mentioned July 2024
milestones.description: Reporting described a revised year-end target, with train availability a principal dependency.
milestones.comments: Precise announcement provenance and intervening targets are not fully established.

milestones.title: First confirmed mainline movement
milestones.description: The first slow trial movement left Hebbagodi depot, with departure reported at 18:55.
milestones.comments: A limited-section movement, not evidence of full-corridor testing or completion of signalling integration.

milestones.title: Civil work and track installation reported complete
milestones.description: Officials described civil work as complete, tracks and signalling installed, and rail grinding finished.
milestones.comments: Completion was reported by this date; no exact completion day or formal certificate is established. Full-line third-rail energisation was still anticipated by May-end.

milestones.title: First reported full-corridor trial run
milestones.description: A train ran the full route, stopping at intermediate stations.
milestones.comments: Does not establish the start or completion of the entire integrated signalling test programme.

milestones.title: RDSO oscillation and emergency-braking trials begin
milestones.description: BMRCL announced a roughly 12-14-day oscillation and EBD trial programme.
milestones.comments: Testing commencement, not clearance. The announced scope must not be expanded to the entire corridor.

milestones.title: January 2025 opening plan reported
milestones.description: BMRCL envisaged inspection in December and sufficient trains by November-December; civil and systems work was described as substantially complete.
milestones.comments: Conditional plan. Exact release day and final completion certificates are not established.

milestones.title: Reduced-fleet opening considered
milestones.description: The BMRCL MD said a reduced-fleet opening was being considered.
milestones.comments: An exploratory option, not a fixed launch announcement. Interview day unspecified.

milestones.title: RDSO train-design clearance reported
milestones.description: A BMRCL official subsequently said RDSO cleared the new train design on this date.
milestones.comments: Reported technical clearance; the underlying document remains unlocated. Not passenger-opening authorisation.

milestones.title: May 2025 opening target stated
milestones.description: The Deputy CM stated the May target in the Assembly. Rolling-stock shortage was identified as a delay factor.
milestones.comments: Statement reported on 10 March; the event date is 4 March.

milestones.title: Opening forecast moves beyond May
milestones.description: Statutory rolling-stock and multi-train tests were reported conducted, while ISA/signalling assessment remained pending.
milestones.comments: Reporting date and forecast, not a formally fixed opening date or exact test-completion date.

milestones.title: ISA certification reportedly issued
milestones.description: Contemporary reporting on Saturday 19 July says certification was issued on Thursday; BMRCL confirmed receipt of the ISA report.
milestones.comments: 17 July is derived from the explicit weekday reference. A retrospective instead gives 19 July. The conflict remains unresolved pending the certificate.

milestones.title: Mid-August opening expectation reported
milestones.description: A former BMRCL MD expected an opening by mid-August, conditional on certification and inspection.
milestones.comments: A reported expectation; exact announcement day is not established.

milestones.title: CMRS corridor inspection
milestones.description: The safety commissioner inspected the corridor over this interval, according to reporting based on the inspection report.
milestones.comments: Separate from earlier train-only inspections.

milestones.title: Dated CMRS report and conditional authorisation
milestones.description: Reporting identifies a safety report dated 30 July permitting GoA-2 operation with drivers, rather than unattended GoA-4 operation.
milestones.comments: Another account gives 1 August as the clearance date. The signed report and opening order are needed to resolve this. ATS integration, training, manuals and cybersecurity validation were among outstanding matters.

milestones.title: August 10 inauguration announced
milestones.description: A Union minister announced the inauguration date.
milestones.comments: Ceremonial target; ordinary passenger services began on August 11.

milestones.title: Yellow Line inaugurated
milestones.description: The Prime Minister inaugurated the Yellow Line.
milestones.comments: Ceremonial opening; distinct from the following day's passenger-service commencement.

milestones.title: Passenger operations begin
milestones.description: Commercial services began, with the first departure reported at 06:30. A reporter travelled on the first service.

green.name: Green Line
green.scope: Five passenger-opening stages: Sampige Road - Peenya Industry; Peenya Industry - Nagasandra; Sampige Road - Yelachenahalli; Yelachenahalli - Silk Institute; Nagasandra - Madavara

milestones.title: Original Phase 1 DPR submitted
milestones.scope: Shared Phase 1 project, including the original north-south corridor
milestones.description: DMRC submitted the original two-corridor DPR, including approximately 14.9 km from Yeshwanthpur to RV Road.
milestones.comments: Exact submission day is not established. This is a project-wide record, not a separate Green Line-only approval.

milestones.title: Original Phase 1 receives Union sanction
milestones.description: Union sanction included the original north-south corridor.
milestones.comments: The original state approval date remains unverified; this Union date must not substitute for it.

milestones.title: Phase 1 extension DPR submitted in October
milestones.description: CAG records an extension DPR submission in October 2007 as the original project was expanded.
milestones.comments: Original submission letters and exact days were not recovered. The supplied research does not identify which addition belongs to each submission month.

milestones.title: Further Phase 1 extension DPR submitted
milestones.description: CAG records a further extension DPR submission in June 2008.
milestones.comments: Month precision only; no unsupported assignment to a particular northward or southward addition is made.

milestones.title: Union approves Phase 1 extensions
milestones.description: Approval of the extensions contributed to the enlarged 42.3-km Phase 1 project and 24.2-km Green Line.
milestones.comments: Sanctioned-route, civil-package and operational-section lengths are not interchangeable.

milestones.title: Reach 3B letter of acceptance issued
milestones.description: JMC received the viaduct and three-station package at approximately INR 212.65 crore, with a 27-month period.

milestones.title: Reach 3B agreement signed
milestones.description: The formal Reach 3B agreement was signed.
milestones.comments: The judgment contains an apparent 2022 typo for an original completion year; later passages explicitly identify 2012. These particulars do not establish dates for Reach 3, 3A, 4 or 4A.

milestones.title: Green Line underground package awarded to Coastal-TTS
milestones.description: Specialist construction history places the Coastal-TTS JV award in March 2011.
milestones.comments: Exact agreement date and original value need primary corroboration. This is not Purple Line's CEC-Soma-CICI package.

milestones.title: Karnataka approves Phase 2
milestones.scope: Shared Phase 2 project, including both Green Line extensions
milestones.description: Formal state approval included Yelachenahalli - Anjanapura and Nagasandra - BIEC.

milestones.title: First Green section forecast for April 2013
milestones.description: A forecast accompanying depot-testing coverage expected the initial Green section in April 2013; it was subsequently missed.
milestones.comments: Full article access was blocked in the supplied research; indexed text supported the target. The depot tests are not classified as mainline testing.

milestones.title: North-south tunnelling commences
milestones.description: Coastal-TTS began tunnelling the north-south corridor.
milestones.comments: Retrospective evidence establishes December, not an exact commencement day.

milestones.title: Northern mainline trials begin
milestones.description: Trials began on a limited part of Reach 3, as reported the following day.
milestones.comments: This is the first confirmed northern mainline start located in the supplied research, not a claim that no earlier movement occurred. The 2012 depot testing is a different milestone.

milestones.title: First-section forecast moves to late November or early December
milestones.description: Reporting forecast initial operation around late November or early December; remaining works and approvals intervened and the window was missed.
milestones.comments: The original announcement date and an exact deadline day are not established.

milestones.title: Union Cabinet approves Phase 2
milestones.scope: Shared Phase 2, including both Green Line extensions
milestones.description: The Cabinet approved the project including the southern Yelachenahalli - Anjanapura and northern Nagasandra - BIEC extensions.

milestones.title: Budget forecasts Phase 1 completion by March 2015
milestones.scope: Shared Phase 1 project, including Purple and Green
milestones.description: The state budget statement forecast Phase 1 completion in March 2015; the target was missed.
milestones.comments: A shared project-wide promise, not an independently countable Green Line-only opening deadline.

milestones.title: Formal Union sanction of Phase 2 issued
milestones.description: Formal sanction followed the January Cabinet approval.

milestones.title: First Green section ceremony and passenger dates announced
milestones.description: The reported ceremony and passenger-service dates were both achieved.

milestones.title: Sampige Road - Peenya Industry inaugurated
milestones.description: The first Green Line section was inaugurated ceremonially.
milestones.comments: Passenger service began the next day, not on the ceremony date.

milestones.title: Sampige Road - Peenya Industry passenger service begins
milestones.description: Public operation began on the first Green Line section.
milestones.comments: Exact preceding CMRS inspection and authorisation dates remain unestablished.

milestones.title: CMRS inspects Reach 3B
milestones.scope: Peenya Industry - Nagasandra stations and Peenya depot
milestones.description: CMRS inspected the three northern extension stations and Peenya depot.
milestones.comments: Primary-authored BMRCL April 2015 newsletter accessed through a third-party mirror; original hosting was not recovered.

milestones.title: Reach 3B receives CMRS authorisation
milestones.description: The authorisation certificate for commercial operations was issued.
milestones.comments: Date from BMRCL's April 2015 newsletter, retained on a third-party mirror.

milestones.title: Peenya Industry - Nagasandra inaugurated
milestones.description: The northern extension was inaugurated; public operation also began that day.

milestones.title: Peenya Industry - Nagasandra passenger service begins
milestones.description: Passenger service began on the same date as the inauguration.

milestones.title: Minister forecasts Phase 1 completion by March 2016
milestones.description: The Union minister forecast Phase 1 completion at the Reach 3B inauguration. The target was missed.
milestones.comments: Not a new deadline for the Reach 3B section that opened that day.

milestones.title: Parliamentary answer forecasts Phase 1 completion by June 2016
milestones.previous_target: December 2013 baseline in this parliamentary answer
milestones.description: The answer cited delayed land possession, litigation, retendering and difficult tunnelling geology. The revised deadline was missed.
milestones.comments: This answer's original baseline differs from CAG's earlier baseline descriptions; do not label all of them the same original deadline or count them again as Green-only promises.

milestones.title: NCC awarded southern Phase 2 civil package
milestones.scope: Reach 4B: Yelachenahalli towards Anjanapura / Silk Institute
milestones.description: NCC was awarded the elevated southern extension and five stations at a reported approximately INR 508.86 crore.
milestones.comments: Exact award day is not established.

milestones.title: Green Line underground tunnelling completed
milestones.description: TBM Krishna's final breakthrough at Majestic completed the tunnelling programme.
milestones.comments: Not completion of stations, tracks or systems.

milestones.title: Train hauled through tunnels to isolated southern section
milestones.scope: Transfer to southern elevated Green Line
milestones.description: A battery locomotive hauled a train through the new tunnels to the isolated southern elevated section.
milestones.comments: An archived contemporary account says November 18; later history says November 19. The day remains disputed. This transfer is not powered mainline testing.

milestones.title: Southern elevated trials begin
milestones.description: Testing began on the southern elevated section before the underground connection opened.
milestones.comments: Exact day differs between secondary accounts; month precision is retained.

milestones.title: Simplex awarded Madavara extension civil works
milestones.description: The viaduct and three-station package was awarded at approximately INR 298.65 crore with a reported 27-month period.
milestones.comments: Exact award day is not established. Do not derive an exact contractual completion day from the month and duration.

milestones.title: Remaining Green Line forecast for April 2017
milestones.scope: Remaining Green Line connection completing Phase 1
milestones.description: The April opening forecast was missed while tunnel sealing, systems tests, trials and safety inspection remained.

milestones.title: Underground powered trials begin in late March
milestones.scope: Sampige Road - National College underground connection
milestones.description: Powered trials connected the northern and southern sections for testing.
milestones.comments: TNIE reports March 30; specialist history says March 31. Neither day is selected as settled, and the two dates are not represented as a testing-duration interval. November 2016 hauling was a different event.

milestones.title: Retrospective recalls successive Phase 1 deadlines
milestones.scope: Shared Phase 1 project; remaining Green Line in the later forecasts
milestones.revised_target: Historical targets recalled: December 2012; March 2015; September 2015; December 2015; November 2016
milestones.description: The retrospective recalled missed project schedules before the final Green connection opened.
milestones.comments: These are historical target claims grouped under their evidence date, not five announcements made in April 2017. Original revision dates are unknown. The November 1 exact-day reading in secondary reporting needs stronger corroboration; November is retained as the supported target month.

milestones.title: Remaining Green opening forecast moves to end-May
milestones.scope: Remaining Green Line connection completing Phase 1
milestones.description: Pending station finishes and time for safety certification pushed the forecast to end-May; that target was also missed.

milestones.title: RDSO speed trials reported to begin
milestones.description: Specialist history reports commencement of the speed-testing programme on May 5.
milestones.comments: Original test report and clearance date were not recovered; a reported trial start is not a clearance certificate.

milestones.title: CMRS inspects final Phase 1 Green section
milestones.description: Contemporary specialist coverage describes a four-day inspection from May 29 through June 1.
milestones.comments: Some agency reporting instead describes three days from May 29. Preserve that interval discrepancy pending original inspection records.

milestones.title: CMRS signs conditional authorisation for remaining Green Line
milestones.description: CMRS signed conditional authorisation on Wednesday evening. Handover was scheduled for Thursday, June 8. Maximum authorised speed was reported as 80 km/h.
milestones.comments: Signing and scheduled handover are different events. Passenger facilities, firefighting/electrical space and minor works required attention; this does not establish unconditional clearance.

milestones.title: June 17 ceremony and June 18 passenger opening announced
milestones.description: The announced dates followed conditional authorisation and were achieved.

milestones.title: Madavara extension construction commences
milestones.description: A January 2024 retrospective dates commencement of the northern extension works to June 9, 2017.
milestones.comments: A contemporary commencement record remains desirable.

milestones.title: Remaining Phase 1 section inaugurated
milestones.scope: Stage 3: Sampige Road - Yelachenahalli; shared Phase 1 dedication
milestones.description: The President dedicated the completed Phase 1 project, including the remaining Green Line connection.
milestones.comments: Ceremony date only; Green passenger operation through to Yelachenahalli began June 18.

milestones.title: Full Phase 1 Green Line passenger operation begins
milestones.description: Public services commenced through to Yelachenahalli, completing Phase 1 Green passenger operation.

milestones.title: Madavara schedule pushed to January 2022
milestones.description: Reporting described repeated delays from land acquisition and contractor finances, with outstanding land from multiple agencies including NICE.
milestones.comments: The January 2022 target was missed. Earlier revisions are retrospective claims, not newly dated announcements. The original agreement is needed to reconcile the 27-month duration, mid-2019 contractual descriptions and reported August 2019 opening target.

milestones.title: Silk Institute extension trials begin
milestones.description: Initial low-speed infringement checks began on the new southern extension. The account also reports subsequent September high-speed testing.

milestones.title: Silk Institute forecast shifts from August 15 to November 1
milestones.description: Coverage forecast November 1 opening after the August target was missed.
milestones.comments: BMRCL's chief PRO later disputed that November 1 had been specifically promised, saying the target was November. The clarification is retained separately; do not count both as independent promises.

milestones.title: Retrospective recalls earlier Phase 2 and southern schedules
milestones.scope: Phase 2 DPR ambition and Silk Institute civil/extension schedules
milestones.revised_target: Phase 2 DPR ambition 2016; southern civil target end-2018; later mid-2019 and mid-2020 forecasts
milestones.description: The account recalled an earlier Phase 2 ambition and successive missed southern-extension schedules, including land and right-of-way delays.
milestones.comments: Original revision announcements were not established. The end-2018 target concerns civil completion, not passenger opening; the 2016 DPR ambition was not an executed contractor deadline.

milestones.title: BMRCL disputes November 1 as a specific promised date
milestones.description: The chief PRO said the target was November rather than a specifically promised November 1.
milestones.comments: Preserves a disputed reading of an existing target, not a new independent deadline.

milestones.title: CMRS inspects Silk Institute extension
milestones.description: The two-day inspection covered infrastructure, systems and passenger facilities.
milestones.comments: November 18-19, not December 18-19 as stated in some summaries.

milestones.title: Southern opening forecast for late November or early December
milestones.revised_target: Month-end November or first week December 2020
milestones.description: After inspection, report preparation, compliance and inauguration arrangements remained. The forecast window was missed.

milestones.title: Silk Institute extension authorised with 37 conditions
milestones.description: CMRS approval was received with 37 conditions covering matters including electrical/fire safety and remaining civil defects.
milestones.comments: Conditional authorisation is not unconditional completion of all remaining work.

milestones.title: Silk Institute forecast moves to mid-December
milestones.description: Reporting forecast mid-December opening and retrospectively listed November 30 as another missed target. The December forecast was also missed.
milestones.comments: The original November 30 exact-date announcement was not located; it is not added as a separate precisely dated promise.

milestones.title: Silk Institute ceremony and passenger opening announced
milestones.description: The announced dates were achieved. The retrospective also described pandemic disruption, equipment supply and skilled-labour shortages behind earlier delay.

milestones.title: Silk Institute extension inaugurated
milestones.description: The southern extension was ceremonially inaugurated.
milestones.comments: Public service began the following morning, not on the ceremony date.

milestones.title: Silk Institute passenger service begins
milestones.description: Commercial operation began the morning after inauguration.

milestones.title: Madavara opening forecast for August 2023
milestones.description: February reporting forecast an August opening; the target was missed.
milestones.comments: Only the evidence month is established in the supplied research, not an exact announcement day.

milestones.title: Madavara final precast segment launched overnight
milestones.description: Simplex completed the final precast segment launch during the night of April 30/May 1.
milestones.comments: Not station, track, systems or overall civil completion. Contemporary credit to Simplex must be reconciled with retrospective claims of cancellation/reassignment; no replacement-contract event is inferred.

milestones.title: September 2023 Madavara opening window reported
milestones.description: Reporting suggested a September opening window, which was missed.
milestones.comments: A likely opening forecast, not a recovered formal commitment.

milestones.title: Madavara opening forecast moves from April to July
milestones.description: Track work, trials and CMRS inspection remained. Reporting described protests, supplier problems, NICE access and pandemic delays. The July forecast was missed.

milestones.title: Madavara forecast moves to end-September
milestones.description: Electrical/signalling systems, third rail and testing remained, pushing the forecast later. The end-September target was missed.

milestones.title: Madavara public-opening window widens into October
milestones.scope: Nagasandra - Madavara passenger opening; trials separately planned
milestones.description: The MD's revised public-opening window anticipated inspection in September and proposed trials from August 6. The opening window was missed.
milestones.comments: The planned August 6 trial start is not itself proof that trials actually began that day.

milestones.title: Madavara trials begin in August; exact day unresolved
milestones.description: Reports place trial commencement in August, with August 6 and August 17 both claimed.
milestones.comments: August 6 was first announced as a plan and later described retrospectively as the start; contemporary Indian Express reporting says Saturday, August 17. No unsupported distinction between two testing stages is invented.

milestones.title: Unofficial Madavara forecast spans October-November
milestones.description: An unofficial source forecast opening within October-November; the eventual November 7 opening fell inside this broad window.
milestones.comments: Not a formal announced date and not a missed target.

milestones.title: CMRS inspects Madavara extension
milestones.description: Statutory inspection covered the new northern extension.

milestones.title: Madavara receives conditional CMRS authorisation
milestones.description: A six-page sanction letter authorised commercial operation subject to conditions covering safety, operations, civil/track, electrical, stations and signalling.
milestones.comments: Moneycontrol reported inspecting the letter. This is conditional authorisation, not passenger-service commencement.

milestones.title: Madavara opening forecast within October
milestones.description: After conditional sanction, compliance and government/inauguration arrangements remained. The October opening forecast was missed.

milestones.title: Ministerial inspection ride reaches Madavara
milestones.description: The Deputy CM and other representatives rode to Madavara ahead of public opening.
milestones.comments: Not automatically a formal inauguration; a separate ceremony was described as a later event.

milestones.title: November 7 Madavara public opening announced
milestones.description: The announcement was achieved the following morning, while a separate formal ceremony was deferred.

milestones.title: Madavara passenger service begins
milestones.description: The extension opened to passengers at 5 am, completing the currently operating Green Line at the research cutoff.
milestones.comments: Contemporary opening-day reports support November 7. A later ministry-summary report says November 17 and conflicts with those records; it does not replace the opening date. A separate formal inauguration date remains unestablished.

pink.name: Pink Line
pink.scope: Kalena Agrahara - Nagawara; elevated section to Tavarekere / SG Palya

milestones.title: Phase 2 DPR preparation authorised
milestones.description: Karnataka permitted preparation of the Phase 2 DPR, including the north-south corridor that became the Pink Line.
milestones.comments: Permission to prepare the DPR, not its submission, approval or construction sanction. Early IIMB / Gottigere alignment descriptions must not automatically be treated as identical to the final sanctioned corridor.

milestones.title: Karnataka Phase 2 approval
milestones.description: Karnataka formally approved Phase 2, including Reach 6.
milestones.comments: Formal approval, distinct from earlier in-principle decisions.

milestones.title: Union Cabinet approval
milestones.scope: Phase 2, including the new north-south corridor
milestones.description: The Union Cabinet approved Bengaluru Metro Phase 2, including the new corridor that became the Pink Line.

milestones.title: Formal Union sanction
milestones.description: Formal Union government sanction followed Cabinet approval.
milestones.comments: Separate from the 30 January Cabinet decision; approval documents are reproduced in the Legislative Council reply.

milestones.title: Simplex elevated contract signed
milestones.description: The Simplex elevated civil agreement was signed.
milestones.comments: CAG Report No. 7 of 2026, Annexure XIV, printed page 151. This establishes the agreement date, not the disputed award month or first physical construction date.

milestones.title: L&T underground packages awarded
milestones.description: L&T received the awards for the RT02 and RT03 underground civil packages.
milestones.comments: The BMRCL annual report distinguishes award from subsequent agreement signing.

milestones.title: L&T publicly announces underground awards
milestones.description: L&T publicly announced the underground contracts in a stock-exchange release.
milestones.comments: Announcement date, not the award or agreement date.

milestones.title: L&T RT02 and RT03 agreements signed
milestones.description: The agreements for both L&T underground packages were signed.
milestones.comments: CAG Report No. 7 of 2026, Annexure XIV.

milestones.title: AFCONS RT01 agreement signed
milestones.description: The AFCONS underground civil-package agreement was signed.
milestones.comments: CAG Report No. 7 of 2026, Annexure XIV.

milestones.title: ITD RT04 agreement signed
milestones.description: The ITD underground civil-package agreement was signed.
milestones.comments: CAG Annexure XIV supports 13 December; conflicting reporting gives 12 December. The agreement date follows the CAG record.

milestones.title: Urja builds the first tunnelling ring
milestones.description: TBM Urja began the initial tunnelling drive with its first ring.
milestones.comments: The retrospective quotes BMRCL. Broader July / August descriptions concern the tunnelling programme, not necessarily this first-ring milestone.

milestones.title: Kothanur depot contract signed
milestones.description: The depot civil agreement supporting the Pink Line was signed.
milestones.comments: CAG Report No. 7 of 2026, Annexure XIV.

milestones.title: Simplex contract terminated
milestones.description: The Simplex agreement was terminated for non-performance, requiring procurement of a replacement contractor.
milestones.comments: Preferred date: TNIE's contemporary 6 February report explicitly gives 29 January; AIIB also supports January. A retrospective BMRCL report gives 29 June. The conflict is retained without an invented explanation.

milestones.title: Earlier elevated construction deadlines recorded as missed
milestones.scope: Elevated construction contract, not passenger opening
milestones.description: Contemporary reporting discussed missed 2019 and 2020 elevated construction deadlines.
milestones.comments: Original agreement and extension dates have not been established. These are construction deadlines, not verified passenger-opening targets; 7 June is the evidence date only.

milestones.title: March 2025 corridor deadline reported
milestones.description: A March 2025 corridor deadline was reported amid contractor termination, replacement procurement and pandemic disruption.
milestones.comments: Missed. An earlier opening target and the original announcement date are not established. This forecast was reported before the December 2024 forecast published in 2023; the claims are not rearranged into a single revision sequence.

milestones.title: GR replacement agreement and works resumption
milestones.description: The GR replacement agreement was signed and elevated works resumed in August.
milestones.comments: The exact signing day is not established. The 21-month duration runs from agreement signing, not the 3 August letter of award; an exact contractual completion day is not calculated.

milestones.title: GR replacement letter of award issued
milestones.description: GR Infraprojects received the letter of award for the remaining elevated works.
milestones.comments: The primary filing specifies 21 months from agreement signing, not from this letter's date.

milestones.title: December 2024 launch or completion forecast reported
milestones.description: A report forecast a December 2024 launch in its headline while discussing completion of work in the body.
milestones.comments: Missed, but the promised milestone is ambiguous. Original announcement date and earlier target are not established. The March 2025 forecast was already reported in 2021; this is a separate sourced claim, not its assumed predecessor.

milestones.title: March 2025 target described as unlikely
milestones.description: Unexpected rock slowed the final TBMs and made the March 2025 corridor target unlikely.
milestones.comments: No replacement opening date was announced here. August / September 2024 references concern tunnelling completion, not passenger opening.

milestones.title: Final elevated precast segment launched
milestones.description: The final elevated precast segment was launched near Jayadeva.
milestones.comments: A structural milestone, not completion of all civil works, stations or systems.

milestones.title: Underground tunnelling completed
milestones.description: Bhadra's final breakthrough completed the Pink Line tunnelling programme.
milestones.comments: Station construction, track and systems remained separate workstreams. This is not a whole-line civil-completion certificate.

milestones.title: December-based phased schedule reported
milestones.description: Reporting placed elevated opening in December 2025 and underground opening in December 2026.
milestones.comments: The elevated target was missed; the underground target was later superseded. Indexed DH text supports both dates, but full-page access was blocked in the supplied research. Original announcement date is not established. Retain separately from the competing September 2025 / June 2026 schedule recorded in the research notes.

milestones.title: March and September 2026 phased targets reported
milestones.description: A revised phased schedule was reported amid continuing construction delays.
milestones.comments: Both targets were missed. Secondary reporting implies a 14 May announcement, but the original statement was not recovered. The stored date is publication only.

milestones.title: Ministry confirms the March and September 2026 schedule
milestones.revised_target: March 2026 elevated commissioning; September 2026 underground completion
milestones.description: A dated MoHUA statement confirmed the phased schedule already reported in May.
milestones.comments: The elevated wording is commissioning; the underground wording is completion. Both were missed. This reaffirms earlier reported targets rather than establishing two newly announced deadlines. The quoted statement does not establish a specific reason for the revision.

milestones.title: Elevated opening pushed to May 2026
milestones.description: Prototype availability, testing and approvals were cited as the elevated forecast moved to May.
milestones.comments: The elevated target was missed. December 2026 was also reported for the underground section; the exact announcement date of its September-to-December revision is not established.

milestones.title: AIIB corroborates the revised phased schedule
milestones.scope: Elevated and underground sections; report status as of November
milestones.description: AIIB's December monitoring report corroborated the revised schedule using a November status snapshot.
milestones.comments: The elevated target was missed. AIIB uses a different baseline from intervening public reports. Financing and loan-closing extensions are not opening deadlines. No exact report publication day is established.

milestones.title: Elevated opening forecast widens to end-May or June
milestones.description: The forecast widened to accommodate testing and statutory processes.
milestones.comments: Missed. No exact June opening day was established.

milestones.title: First elevated mainline trial movement
milestones.description: Preliminary slow-speed movement and field integration checks began on the elevated mainline.
milestones.comments: The report was published on 10 January. Distinct from the later RDSO oscillation and braking programme; individual trainset milestones remain in trainsets.json.

milestones.title: RDSO oscillation and emergency-braking trials
milestones.description: The actual 12-day oscillation and emergency-braking programme ran on the elevated section.
milestones.comments: 9 May is the established actual finish in the supplied research. The earlier scheduled finish of 12 May is not substituted for it.

milestones.title: August 15 internal opening target reported
milestones.description: An internal oral target was reported while station and depot works, staffing and approvals remained pending.
milestones.comments: Missed. Initially attributed to an anonymous source; the article explicitly said no official revised-deadline statement had been issued. Retain separately from later ministerial attribution.

milestones.title: RDSO oscillation report received
milestones.description: The RDSO oscillation report was received, with an official describing design-speed clearance.
milestones.comments: Updated DH wording identifies the oscillation-report stage. Earlier wording called it a speed certificate; it is not conflated with the separate August Interim Speed Certificate.

milestones.title: August 15 elevated target reaffirmed; underground moves to March 2027
milestones.description: A ministerial statement gave stronger attribution to the August 15 target and a March 2027 underground forecast.
milestones.comments: The elevated target was missed. The underground target was later superseded, not already missed as of 22 November 2026. Exact statement day is not established; the stored date is the report date.

milestones.title: Interim Speed Certificate received in early August
milestones.description: Receipt of the Interim Speed Certificate was reported for early August, separately from the June oscillation report.
milestones.comments: Exact issue and receipt days are not established. The month-only timeline position does not assert receipt on 1 August.

milestones.title: Rolling-stock safety inspection
milestones.description: A safety inspection associated with rolling-stock approval was conducted over this interval.
milestones.comments: Reported on 3 September. Separate from October's statutory corridor inspection.

milestones.title: Underground track laying reported complete
milestones.description: The BMRCL MD reported underground track laying as complete.
milestones.comments: An evidence bound: the exact completion day is not established.

milestones.title: Elevated forecast moves to late September
milestones.description: The BMRCL MD forecast opening in the last week of September, with safety observations and further approvals outstanding.
milestones.comments: Missed. A conditional forecast, not an unconditional opening commitment.

milestones.title: Underground electrification described as nearly complete
milestones.description: Reporting quoting the BMRCL MD described underground electrification as nearing completion.
milestones.comments: A progress report, not evidence of actual electrification completion.

milestones.title: September elevated and mid-2027 underground forecasts reported
milestones.description: Following a minister's 22 August inspection, a report forecast September for elevated opening and mid-2027 for the underground section.
milestones.comments: The elevated target was missed. The introduction says the first week of September, but the quoted official says only September. Preserve this conflicting precision separately from the 20 August last-week forecast, not as a confirmed reversal. Mid-2027 is a broad future forecast.

milestones.title: Signalling ISA certificate reported received
milestones.description: Contemporary reporting described the signalling ISA certificate as received.
milestones.comments: Exact issue and receipt days are not established. The original certificate was not recovered; this is a reporting bound.

milestones.title: Railway Board provisional rolling-stock sanction announced
milestones.scope: BEML rolling stock supporting elevated operation
milestones.description: BMRCL announced provisional Railway Board sanction for the BEML rolling stock.
milestones.comments: Reported conditions include six-car operation, GoA2 and speed limits depending on suspension state. These belong to the Board sanction, not automatically to the later CMRS order. Original signed sanction and complete conditions remain unverified.

milestones.title: Elevated opening forecast moves to mid-October
milestones.description: Reports forecast a mid-October elevated opening while further approvals remained pending.
milestones.comments: Missed. Original announcement date is not established; attribution is weaker than a direct BMRCL release.

milestones.title: Opening window described as after October 15
milestones.description: An earliest opening window was reported while CMRS clearance remained pending.
milestones.comments: A lower-bound window, not a precise deadline that can independently be labelled missed.

milestones.title: CMRS corridor inspection
milestones.scope: Elevated corridor, depot and operations control centre
milestones.description: The three-day inspection covered mainline infrastructure, depot and train testing, and the operations control centre.
milestones.comments: Separate from the August rolling-stock inspection.

milestones.title: CMRS safety observations reported
milestones.description: Reporting identified 36 safety observations requiring compliance.
milestones.comments: The exact issue date of the observations is not established.

milestones.title: Underground opening targeted for May 2027
milestones.previous_target: March 2027; a separate report used the broader mid-2027 forecast
milestones.description: Underground opening was targeted for May 2027, dependent on platform-screen doors, signalling and systems integration.
milestones.comments: A future target, not a missed deadline as of 22 November 2026. The earlier precise and broad forecasts are retained rather than collapsed into one assumed revision sequence.

milestones.title: Elevated section receives CMRS authorisation
milestones.description: The elevated section received statutory CMRS authorisation.
milestones.comments: Complete signed-order conditions remain unverified. Railway Board rolling-stock conditions must not automatically be attributed to this order.

milestones.title: November 15 inauguration proposed tentatively
milestones.description: Following CMRS authorisation, a tentative ceremony date was proposed while a PMO appointment remained unconfirmed.
milestones.comments: A changed appointment, not a missed passenger-service deadline. Inauguration subsequently took place earlier, on 13 November.

milestones.title: November 13 inauguration date reported
milestones.description: Sources reported confirmation of a 13 November inauguration.
milestones.comments: Reported confirmation, not a recovered original PMO appointment document. The ceremony took place on the reported date.

milestones.title: November 14 passenger-service commencement announced
milestones.description: Public-service commencement was announced for 6 am on 14 November and was subsequently achieved.
milestones.comments: Passenger opening is distinct from the preceding day's inauguration.

milestones.title: Elevated Pink Line inaugurated
milestones.scope: Kalena Agrahara - SG Palya elevated section, approximately 7.5 km
milestones.description: The elevated section was formally inaugurated.
milestones.comments: Ceremonial opening only; passenger service began the following day. The full Kalena Agrahara - Nagawara corridor is approximately 21.25 km, including approximately 13.76 km underground.

milestones.title: Elevated passenger service begins
milestones.scope: Kalena Agrahara - Tavarekere / SG Palya elevated section
milestones.description: Passenger services began at 6 am on the elevated section.
milestones.comments: This does not establish underground opening or induction of individual trainsets; those records remain separate.

milestones.title: Underground trial access awaits permission
milestones.scope: Buffer beyond SG Palya towards the underground section
milestones.description: BMRCL sought permission to remove the buffer beyond SG Palya so trial movements could enter the underground section.
milestones.comments: A permission request, not evidence that underground mainline trials had commenced. Actual first underground mainline movement remains unestablished by this report.

milestones.title: May 2027 underground target reaffirmed
milestones.description: The May 2027 underground opening target was reaffirmed while trial access still awaited permission to remove the SG Palya buffer.
milestones.comments: No new extension is established. This remains a future target as of 22 November 2026, not a missed deadline or an actual opening date.
